author: Uray1130

notes: Green trilingual locality sign, Kathmandu, shot from below; dented, with a damaged spot on ट. The top line is in Ranjana (Nepal Lipi) script, which has no Unicode encoding, so it is not transcribed and is not part of the lines.

author: Kamal Ratna Tuladhar
attribution: Photo: Kamal Ratna Tuladhar, CC0 1.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Tyoura_street_sign.jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: Green trilingual locality sign (Tyora Tol), Kathmandu; same series as c20450743 but a different place. The top line is in Ranjana script (no Unicode encoding) and is not transcribed. Peeling paint over the lower half.

author: Gozitano
attribution: Photo: Gozitano, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Melamchi_shop.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.latin: yahan khana, nasta ra basnako (here food, snacks and lodging)

notes: Hand-painted black board over a roadside eatery; the address 'Zero Kilo' and 'Muglin' suggest Mugling rather than Melamchi as in the source title. The sentence ends with a slash-like danda. Distractors: red fascia 'प्रकाशभोजनाल[य]' (last letter hidden behind the board), Tuborg, Pepsi and F&N crates, painter credit at lower left. A child is seated in the foreground (incidental).

author: Joshgreene
attribution: Photo: Joshgreene, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Sign_for_the_Devi_Ma_Hospital_in_Sipadol_Nepal.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.latin: Devi Ma Ayurved Gramin Chikitsalaya (Devi Ma Ayurveda Rural Hospital)

notes: Hand-painted hospital board, Sipadol, Bhaktapur. The Devanagari title is transcribed as painted, including the anusvara over वें in आयुर्वेंद and the spelling ग्रामिण. Smaller lines not labelled: 'Reg. No.:- 704/7-063', 'S.W.C. No:- 20084', 'देवी माँ कुञ्जद्वारा संचालित / Run by DEVI MA KUNJA', 'स्थापित:- २०५९', the Devanagari place line (a small mark over the first syllable is unclear), and the round logo.
source_title: File:Sign for the Devi Ma Hospital in Sipadol Nepal.jpg

author: AdwaitComred
attribution: Photo: AdwaitComred, CC BY-SA 3.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rara_Sign_board.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Two hand-painted yellow boards behind a log fence. In राष्ट्रिय the hand-painted ट in the conjunct ष्ट्रि has a tail that could also be read as ड; the standard spelling ट is used. The stapit date is in Devanagari digits.

author: Krishna k. sahh
attribution: Photo: Krishna k. sahh, CC0 1.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Trail_signboard_at_Sano_Deurali_in_Shivapuri_Nagarjun_National_Park.jpg. License: http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/deed.en. Unmodified original.
notes: Yellow trail junction board in Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park; only the central circle (the place name) is labelled. Directional panels around it are distractors: NAGI GUMBA (नागी गुम्बा), HELIPAD (हेलिप्याड), SHIVAPURI PEAK (शिवपुरी चुचुरो), BAGHOWAR (बाघद्वार), plus 'HELP US TO KEEP THE NATIONAL PARK CLEAN'. Shaded forest, slightly soft focus.
source_title: File:Trail signboard at Sano Deurali in Shivapuri Nagarjun National Park.jpg

author: Jeena Maharjan
attribution: Photo: Jeena Maharjan, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Arjun_Art_Gallery,_Patan_Durbar_Square_Marg,_Lalitpur.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Hand-painted shop board, Patan (Lalitpur), with cables crossing its right end; a small phone number at lower right is not labelled. Distractors: 'ESPRESSO Coffee Available' board, partly visible red script lightbox ('...Temple') above, paintings.
source_title: File:Arjun Art Gallery, Patan Durbar Square Marg, Lalitpur.jpg

author: Roshanbdrkhatri
attribution: Photo: Roshanbdrkhatri, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Jiri_Hospital_signboard.JPG. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Red-on-white overhead hospital banner, Jiri, Dolakha. Smaller header lines (नेपाल सरकार, ministry and department names) and a phone number cut off at the right edge are not labelled. Nepal emblem at left, 'H' box at right.

author: Christopher J Fynn
attribution: Photo: Christopher J Fynn, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Alchemist_Academy_sign~Jorpati.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.

lines.latin: Alkemisht Ekedemi Ma.Vi. (Alchemist Academy Secondary School)

notes: Vinyl school direction banner, Jorpati, Kathmandu. Smaller lines not labelled: motto in quotes under the logo, 'दुर सञ्चार अगाडि' (in front of the telecom office), phone number 'फोन: ४९१२२६७', and the arrow panel '६० मिटर अगाडि' (60 metres ahead).

author: Raju Babu
attribution: Photo: Raju Babu, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Signboard_at_Sagarmatha_Airport_construction_area.jpg. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: Small blue/white board at a distance in a field with haystacks, marking the Sagarmatha (Nijgadh) airport construction site. A third small line (municipality/ward address) is too small to read and is not labelled. Lens flare at right.
source_title: File:Signboard at Sagarmatha Airport construction area.jpg
